claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18650 2100mAh 30A as a 2100mAh preset with a 30A runtime rating.
Historical evidence records the Efest 18650 2100mAh 30A wrapper as purple, flat-top, and unprotected; independent testing of one purple sample rated it at 20A continuous rather than the 30A label.

The Efest IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 18650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015-09-12 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: The purple flat-top wrapper and a 20A test result are documented, but Efest revisions can contain different underlying cells and the exact OEM identity is not established.
checks: Match the exact purple wrapper revision and markings before applying the test result.
Inspect label layout, wrapper, and terminal against a known-good sample.
Do not infer the underlying OEM cell from Efest branding alone.
